news.title: Marilynne Robinson looks back on 25 years at Iowa
news.summary_en: What began as a two-year teaching appointment turned into 25 years at Iowa for acclaimed novelist and Iowa Writers’ Workshop professor emerita Marilynne Robinson. As she prepares to receive the UI’s Distinguished Alumni Award, Robinson shares how the university’s rich history inspired her writing and how its community became a cherished part of her life.

news.title: Ultimate team effort: Behind the scenes at Kinnick Stadium on game day
news.summary_en: The action on the field may last only a few hours, but the work that goes into a Kinnick game day starts long before kickoff. From student equipment managers and security staff to the DJ who keeps the crowd energized, meet the folks working behind the scenes to make every game day unforgettable.
